_note: Hand-written list of shipped CyberView Scanner features for the Scanner page's 'Recently added' section (site/scanner.html). scripts/scanner-stats.mjs validates it at build and copies it into site/data/scanner.json. Public text only: a title, one plain line, the merge date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the pull request number. Newest first; add an entry when a scanner pull request merges.

recent.title: Report viewer and scope builder
recent.line: This page can now open your scanner's report.json files and show what changed between two scans, and build a checked scope file for you. Both run in your browser only; nothing is uploaded.

recent.title: 55 researched fingerprints
recent.line: 55 more products named from public reference fingerprints, using only the root page, certificate, greeting and DNS answer the scan already reads. No extra request.

recent.title: Identify hellos and DNS records (opt-in)
recent.line: Off by default. --identify asks each mail, RTSP, SIP, mDNS, RDP, SMB and LDAP service one standard question without logging in; --dns-records checks SPF, DMARC, CAA, BIMI and MTA-STS for your own domains.

recent.title: Industrial identification (--ics)
recent.line: Off by default. One read-only identification request per industrial or clinical protocol (Modbus, S7, EtherNet/IP, BACnet, OPC UA, DICOM), private addresses only, never a write.

recent.title: Dependency map, imports and offline rematch
recent.line: --depmap maps how scanned services relate, with a risk score per host; your own SBOMs, package lists and exports can be added, and an old scan can be re-checked against newer data without scanning again.

recent.title: 20 more products from collected data
recent.line: Helpdesks, monitoring, remote management, building and industrial panels, cameras and IP phones, named from the root page, headers and certificate the scan already read.

recent.title: Single-file download and releases
recent.line: Scanner releases are built by CI from a tagged commit as one file, with SHA256SUMS to check it, and published on GitHub Releases.

recent.title: HTTP path rail (--paths)
recent.line: Off by default. With --paths, up to 8 extra read-only GETs per host of 39 reviewed version paths, only for products the root page, headers or certificate already pointed to.

recent.title: Report pack
recent.line: --certs writes a certificate inventory with reuse across hosts, --mail a mail TLS sheet, --compare a diff against a previous scan, and the offline coverage command lists known-exploited products it cannot yet name.

recent.title: Application and service fingerprints
recent.line: Web frameworks, file transfer, NAS, mail, monitoring and remote-management consoles, proxies, databases and cameras, named from the root page, certificate and greeting the scan already read.

recent.title: Incident citations and hunt links
recent.line: With --data-incidents, each finding cites the reviewed CyberView incidents that name its CVE (claims are never cited), and every finding links the publishers' detection files.

recent.title: Edge appliance fingerprints
recent.line: VPN gateways, firewalls, routers, cameras and NAS that CISA lists as known exploited, named from the root page, headers and greeting the scan already collected. No extra request.

recent.title: CMS, plugin and JavaScript library versions
recent.line: Versions a site discloses in its own root page markup (generator tags, script file names, library banners), read without fetching anything more.

recent.title: Self-contained HTML report
recent.line: --html writes report.html: one page with no script, nothing loaded from the network, evidence for each finding, the backport caveat and coverage notes.

recent.title: SSH key exchange audit
recent.line: Reads the algorithms an SSH server offers on the same connection, flags a weak set and notes post-quantum key exchange. It never starts a key exchange or logs in.

recent.title: HTTP and mail hygiene
recent.line: Security headers, cookie flags (names only), redirects, default, setup and debug pages, and cleartext mail and logins, from the one root-page response.

recent.title: TLS and certificate hygiene
recent.line: Expired or expiring certificates, self-signed, weak keys and signatures, old protocols, weak ciphers and no forward secrecy, from the one handshake.

recent.title: The CyberView Scanner
recent.line: The downloadable, detection-only scanner: scope file and attestation, discovery, every-port and UDP depth, offline data, and JSON, CSV, SARIF and software-list output.
